title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented University at Buffalo library study settings spanning silent reading rooms, private rooms, carrels, booths, and collaborative spaces.

cards.title: Austin Flint Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Abbott Library, 2nd floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing that benefits from silence; the library identifies this as a silent room for uninterrupted, concentrated work.
cards.short_summary: A named silent reading room in Abbott Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes the Austin Flint Main Reading Room as a picturesque, silent reading room for deep focus and uninterrupted study.
cards.source_title: Abbott Library - Austin Flint Main Reading Room
cards.access_notes: Located in Abbott Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Abbott Library 2nd Floor Mezzanine Single-Person Study Rooms
cards.title: Abbott Mezzanine Single-Person Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Abbott Library, 2nd-floor mezzanine
cards.notes: Reserve a room before heading over, then use the enclosed single-person setup for a task needing quiet and fewer interruptions.
cards.short_summary: Private single-person rooms for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes these as private, quiet single-person study rooms for focused, distraction-free work; its 2025 update says rooms can be booked up to two hours per day with key pickup at the first-floor service desk.
cards.source_title: Abbott Library - 2nd Floor Mezzanine Single-Person Study Rooms
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Libraries booking system; UB’s April 2025 update specifies up to two hours per day and key pickup at Abbott’s first-floor Library Services Desk.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library 3rd Floor Group Study Room
cards.title: Lockwood 3rd Floor Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, 3rd floor
cards.notes: Use the wall-mounted screen to share work and the whiteboard to outline ideas; reserve ahead when your group needs a defined workspace.
cards.short_summary: A presentation-ready group room with a screen and whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries says this room has a spacious table, wall-mounted screen, and whiteboard for collaborative work and presentations.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library - 3rd Floor Group Study Room
cards.access_notes: Active UB students, faculty, and staff may reserve group study rooms; reservations are limited to one per day for a maximum of two hours.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library 3rd Floor Open Study Carrels
cards.title: Lockwood 3rd Floor Open Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, 3rd floor
cards.notes: Set up solo at a personal desk when you want natural light and a defined workspace without using a closed study room.
cards.short_summary: Individual desks that combine daylight with open-air separation.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries says these carrels provide individual desk areas with natural light and balance privacy with an open, airy layout.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library - 3rd Floor Open Study Carrels
cards.access_notes: Located in Lockwood Memorial Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library 4th Floor Group Study Room
cards.title: Lockwood 4th Floor Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, 4th floor
cards.notes: Bring a team outline or problem set and use the large table and whiteboard to divide tasks, map steps, and compare answers.
cards.short_summary: A large-table collaboration room with a whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries says this large group study room includes a spacious table and whiteboard for group discussions, brainstorming, and planning.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library - 4th Floor Group Study Room
cards.access_notes: Active UB students, faculty, and staff may reserve group study rooms; reservations are limited to one per day for a maximum of two hours.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library 4th Floor Study Area
cards.title: Lockwood 4th Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, 4th floor
cards.notes: Choose this quiet area for longer solo work; claim desk space, connect your device to power, and settle into a focused block.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area with desk space and power access.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes this as a quiet study area with ample desk space and power outlets for personal devices.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library - 4th Floor Study Area
cards.access_notes: Located in Lockwood Memorial Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library 5th Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Lockwood 5th Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, 5th floor
cards.notes: Use a large table for shared laptops and notes, then move the discussion to the whiteboard for planning or problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: Group rooms designed around a table-and-whiteboard workflow.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries says these group rooms are equipped with a large table and whiteboard for collaboration, planning, and problem-solving.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library - 5th Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.access_notes: Active UB students, faculty, and staff may reserve group study rooms; reservations are limited to one per day for a maximum of two hours.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library 5th Floor Individual Study Seating
cards.title: Lockwood 5th Floor Individual Study Seating
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, 5th floor
cards.notes: Pick a side-by-side workstation when privacy dividers will help you keep a personal setup while working independently.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries says this quiet area offers side-by-side individual seating with privacy dividers and a personal workstation for each user.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library - 5th Floor Individual Study Seating
cards.access_notes: Located in Lockwood Memorial Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Oscar A. Silverman Library 3rd Floor Grand Reading Room
cards.title: Silverman Grand Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Oscar A. Silverman Library, 3rd floor
cards.notes: Use this named reading room for writing, reading, or other work that calls for a bright, spacious setting and silent concentration.
cards.short_summary: A bright, spacious silent reading room in Silverman Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes the Grand Reading Room as bright and spacious, suited to reading, writing, and work requiring silent concentration.
cards.source_title: Oscar A. Silverman Library - 3rd Floor Grand Reading Room
cards.access_notes: Silverman Library is listed by UB Libraries as open 24/7 except during intersessions and university holidays; verify current hours and closures before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Oscar A. Silverman Library 3rd Floor Study Booths
cards.title: Silverman 3rd Floor Study Booths
cards.subtitle: Oscar A. Silverman Library, 3rd floor
cards.notes: Settle into a booth for an extended study block when supportive seating and a deliberate layout fit the work better than an open table.
cards.short_summary: Supportive study booths on Silverman’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries says the third-floor study booths provide supportive seating and a layout intended to make extended study more comfortable.
cards.source_title: Oscar A. Silverman Library - 3rd Floor Study Booths
